table structure operations in the canoni.note: A tracked deletion of a table with a vertical merge gives the default engine's tables once resolved; pending cell text inside a deletion counts as the cell's text.
Deleting the row a vertical merge starts hands the merge and its words to the next row.
Accepting a suggested deletion of the row a vertical merge starts hands the merged cell and its words to the next row.
Deleting the row a vertical merge starts, addressed through another cell of that row, puts the caret in the merged cell the next row takes over.

cell merges, splits and column changes i.note: A suggested column deletion through a cell spanning two columns is skipped alike in both engines.
A suggested column deletion addressed through the cell spanning two columns is skipped alike in both engines.
A suggested column deletion on a table with a cell spanning two columns gives the default engine's package or is skipped alike.
Suggested column deletions on a table with a cell spanning two columns give the default engine's package or are skipped alike.
A suggested empty column inserted through a cell spanning both its sides is skipped alike in both engines, since no suggestion widens a cell.
A suggested split of a cell spanning two columns is skipped alike in both engines; a direct split still applies.
Rejecting a suggested split of a vertical merge restores the merge, as the default engine's rejection does.

tables inserted beside paragraphs and ta.note: A tracked signature table beside a pending deleted paragraph break refuses its unsupported mode without moving the existing revision.
